meta.title: Digex | Digital agency in Algeria — branding, websites, content
meta.description: Digex Agency: brand identity, online stores and marketing content for Algerian brands.

hero.headline: Your brand deserves
hero.sub: Brand identity, an online store that sells, content that lands — one team, from the idea to the first sale.

problem.title: In Algeria, the product isn't the problem. <mark>Visibility</mark> is.
problem.lead: A good product with weak branding stays invisible. That's exactly what we fix.

items.title: An identity that doesn't set you apart
items.body: A rushed logo and random colours make you look like every competitor.

items.title: Customers who pass through and never return
items.body: They find you on Facebook, can't find where to buy, and leave.

items.title: A slow site — or no site at all
items.body: Or a store that breaks on mobile, where 90% of your customers are browsing.

items.title: Content with no direction
items.body: Scattered posts with no visual thread build no memory of your brand.

services.title: Everything your brand needs, under one <mark>roof</mark>
services.lead: Five connected services. No more coordinating four freelancers.

development.title: Web development
development.tagline: Sites and stores that actually sell
development.body: Fast online stores, mobile-first, wired for cash-on-delivery and Algerian couriers, with a dashboard you can run without a developer.

brand.title: Brand identity
brand.tagline: A brand recognised at a glance
brand.body: Logo, palette, type, packaging and social templates — delivered as a complete brand book any team can use after us.

marketing.title: Digital marketing
marketing.tagline: Campaigns that reach the right customers
marketing.body: Meta and TikTok campaigns built for the Algerian market: wilaya-level targeting, darija-native content, and weekly reporting.

production.title: Photo & production
production.tagline: Visual content that stops the scroll
production.body: Product photography, short-form video for Reels and TikTok, edited and ready to post.

print.title: Print & packaging
print.body: Packaging, signage, cards and print — quality controlled from design through delivery.

process.title: Five <mark>clear</mark> stages, no surprises
process.lead: You always know where your project stands and what happens next.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We sit down with you: your business, your customers, your competitors. You leave with a written brief.

steps.title: Identity
steps.body: We set the visual direction — logo, colours, type — and lock it before a single line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We develop the site or store, produce the content, and prepare print in parallel.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: We test everything on mobile, connect analytics and payments, and go live.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: We stay after launch: updates, campaigns, and tracking the numbers.

work.title: Projects we <mark>shipped</mark> — you can visit them right now
work.lead: Every project here is real and live. Click through and judge for yourself.

proof.title: Brands that <mark>trust</mark> us
proof.lead: Algerian brands we've taken from identity through to launch.

parfio.title: Parfio — we don't just build sites, we build <mark>software</mark>
parfio.lead: Parfio is our own management system for perfume retailers: inventory, sales, loyalty. Proof that we build real products, not just pages.

features.title: Inventory management
features.body: Every bottle tracked, with alerts before you run out.

features.title: Loyalty programme
features.body: Points and rewards that bring the customer back.

features.title: Analytics
features.body: Clear sales and margin reports, day by day.
